# GFX files of Lunar Magic hacks, as exported by Lunar Magic 3.21 -ExportGFX. Columns:
# headerless ROM SHA-1, SHA-1 of GFX00.bin to GFX33.bin concatenated in that order.
# Lunar Magic will not export from a headerless ROM without asking to add a copier
# header, which stalls a headless run: give it a copy with 512 zero bytes in front.
# QLDC 2021 34_idol (BPS patch; graphics stored as LC_LZ3)
